statement: ∀ n r : ℕ, (Nat.factorial r : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((Nat.factorial (n + r) : ℂ) / (Nat.factorial n : ℂ)) = (Nat.choose (n + r) r : ℂ)
proof:
intro n r
rw [Nat.cast_choose ℂ (show r ≤ n + r by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]
simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
ring

  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  (↑(ell lam) = lam ∧
      0 < ell lam + 1 ∧

          ∀ (r : ℕ), x ((y ^ (r + 1)) v) = (↑(r + 1) * (↑(ell lam) - ↑r)) • (y ^ r) v) →
    ((∀ (i : Idx lam), ev y v ↑i ≠ 0 ∧ h (ev y v ↑i) = (↑(ell lam) - 2 * ↑↑i) • ev y v ↑i) ∧
        (Function.Injective fun i => ↑(ell lam) - 2 * ↑↑i) ∧
          (LinearIndependent ℂ fun i => ev y v ↑i) ∧ ∃ b, ∀ (i : Idx lam), b i = ev y v ↑i) →
      0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
        (FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧
            ↑(Module.finrank ℂ V) = lam + 1 ∧
              ∀ (W : Submodule ℂ V), stable x W → stable y W → stable h W → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) →
